bootstrap_d_fast.signature: (frame_scores, *, repeats=2000, seed=20261023, fixed_methods=None, known_edges=(), min_groups=20, max_group_fraction=0.5)
bootstrap_d_fast.doc:
Common closure bootstrap matching scoring_d's exact draw multiplicities.

Construct all eight video cells once. Source+same-ID+RGB closure must map
every correct/collision video to ONE component. No per-draw frame grouping,
pandas metrics, sorting, or float64 conversion of mpmath rankings occurs.
Return point estimates, pointwise conditional intervals, draw table, closure
metadata, rank metadata, and actual preparation/bootstrap timing.

bootstrap_video_metrics_fast.signature: (videos, *, threshold=None, repeats=2000, seed=20261023, fixed_methods=None, min_groups=20, max_group_fraction=0.5)
bootstrap_video_metrics_fast.doc:
Known-source-group bootstrap of correct video metrics, without row copies.

Integer multiplicities reproduce bootstrap_video_metrics' materialized rows
including repeated FP counts and fixed-method invalidation. Rank/tie groups
are prepared once using original FP64/mpmath score objects.

bootstrap_operating_comparison.signature: (fixed_test, source_threshold, target_thresholds, *, repeats=2000, seed=20261023, min_groups=20, max_group_fraction=0.5, calibration_budget=20)
bootstrap_operating_comparison.doc:
RQ4 target-real mean operating effect versus source on one fixed TEST.

target_thresholds is the recorded common set of 200 n20 calibration
thresholds (other recorded counts/budgets are allowed and labeled). For
video i, acceptance_i = #(threshold_j<=score_i)/J. This exact linear mean
makes each TEST-group bootstrap equivalent to averaging all J explicitly
evaluated thresholds on that SAME draw. Decision ties use >= throughout.

Operates deliberately in the frozen FP64 deployment 'score' space, as
scoring_d.calibration_experiment does. No AUC/ranking calculation occurs.
CAL subset spread is returned separately; percentile intervals concern TEST
resampling conditional on the fixed model/CAL pool/recorded thresholds.

operating_estimator: Mean across the recorded CAL subsets at the fixed TEST pool; CAL subset spread is returned separately.
conditional_scope: Fixed model, full frozen CAL pool, recorded common subsets, known/proxy TEST group graph.
pre_target_rule: Numerical optimization only; no target/cache/model evaluated or inspected. Same seed, sorted IDs, multiplicities, fixed method list, min20/max0.5 gates and pointwise percentile estimator as baseline.
unresolved_ranking: Affected AUC/effects are NaN and CI valid_repeats=0; unrelated comparisons remain available.
multiplicity_export: draws closure_draw_counts/group_draw_counts are sparse Mapping objects. Use dict(mapping) only when JSON export is needed.
limitations: No complete ancestry certification or NP population guarantee.
CAL-pool/Test relation exclusions remain caller manifest responsibility.
One fixed model per call; calibration subsets are never independent models.
Training-seed SD is separate from TEST bootstrap and CAL subset spread.
RQ4 uses frozen FP64 deployment score space, while AUC rank bins preserve original mpmath precision.
min20/max0.5 gates inherited unchanged; they do not establish asymptotic adequacy.
